subject: GreenByte renewal: post-demo volumes, $/1M target & blended routing options
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GreenByte renewal: post-demo volumes, $/1M target & blended routing options

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap + next steps from our side and a couple of clarifying asks so we can get a clean renewal proposal in front of your procurement team.

Recap / what we heard on the call:
- Current monthly tokens: ~9M average (see attached GreenByte_MonthlyUsage_2026.csv)
- Anticipated ramp on new features (search + summarization pipelines): add'l 2-4x over 12 months
- SSO + audit logs required for enterprise contract

Asks from GreenByte (need confirmation):
1) Target unit economics you want to land on (specifically target $/1M tokens for the committed tier)?
2) Which models/routes would you want prioritized for production traffic vs burst (e.g., base cheaper model for bulk, larger model for highest quality responses)?
3) Any fixed monthly budget range (ballpark) we should aim at for the renewal term?

What we'll propose (draft outline):
- 12-mo renewal with volume-step bands (0-50M, 50-200M, 200M+) and blended per-token pricing at each band
- Optional route-add for high-quality LLMs with fallback to a lower-cost route for non-critical traffic
- One-time migration support credit and extended observability retention for first 90 days

If you can confirm the two bullets above (target $/1M and budget range), I’ll get a draft term sheet over to Saeed and procurement by Thursday.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0136

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenbyte.com>

Cc: Saeed Rahman <saeed.rahman@greenbyte.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenByte renewal: post-demo volumes, $/1M target & blended routing options

Ben — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers below.

1) Target $/1M tokens: We'd like to see proposals in the $650–$900 per 1M tokens window for committed tiers. Our 2028 budget planning gives us flexibility toward the lower end if we can lock a 12–24 month commitment and include blended routing for new features.
2) Route priorities: For search traffic we can use a smaller/quantized model 80% of the time; for summarization and customer-facing snippets we need higher quality (~20%). We also expect spikes from marketing campaigns that could triple daily load for short windows.
3) Budget: For the first renewal year aim for $120k–$220k committed spend. If the economics are favorable we can explore step-ups mid-year.

Also attached is our procurement contact's guidance and a csv with weekly peaks through 2026 (thanks for taking a look).

Thanks — Alex
Alex Chen
Head of Product
GreenByte Analytics
alex.chen@greenbyte.com
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@greenbyte.com>, Saeed Rahman <saeed.rahman@greenbyte.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:43:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenByte renewal: post-demo volumes, $/1M target & blended routing options

Alex / Saeed — perfect, that helps a lot. I sketched three commercial options that align with your $/1M and budget targets; attaching a short term sheet (Redwood_Draft_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf) and a one-page pricing summary in the body below so you can share quickly with procurement.

High-level pricing summary (committed 12-mo):
- Option A (Conservative): $900 / 1M tokens for committed tier; 0–50M @ $900, next band 50–200M @ $800 (blended effective depends on usage). Suitable if you want minimal upside risk.
- Option B (Balanced): $775 / 1M starting point with explicit blended routing: default cheap route for search (quantized) + higher-cost route for summarize traffic; includes 10% free token buffer for burst protection.
- Option C (Aggressive ramp): $650 / 1M at commit 200M+ with mid-year step-up credit and capacity reservation. Best if you expect the 2–4x ramp within 6–9 months.

Routing notes:
- We can configure prefix caching and continuous batching for search, which is the primary cost lever; that will materially reduce effective $/1M for that traffic.
- For customer-facing summarizations we route to the higher-quality variant; we can set automated fallbacks to keep tail latency within SLOs if capacity pressure occurs.

Next steps I suggest:
1) Saeed to confirm which option aligns with procurement appetite (A/B/C).
2) If B or C: agree on baseline committed tokens and an anticipated monthly ramp schedule so we can provision Dedicated capacity if needed.
3) If A: we’ll draft final SOW and standard terms (no Dedicated reservation).

Marissa — can you run the blended-rate sketch and draft a quick table showing effective $/1M at sample mixes (80/20, 70/30, 60/40) so Alex can see line-item economics? We’ll include that in the term sheet iteration.

Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Draft_Term_Sheet_v2.pdf (pdf, 95KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2027 16:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenByte renewal: post-demo volumes, $/1M target & blended routing options

Looping in Karthik / finance to validate that the three options are margin-feasible given the expected volume ramp. I ran a quick blended-rate table attached inline here (sample effective $/1M):

- 80% cheap route / 20% high-quality: Option A -> $860 / 1M; Option B -> $740 / 1M; Option C -> $640 / 1M
- 70/30 mix: Option A -> $830 / 1M; Option B -> $710 / 1M; Option C -> $615 / 1M
- 60/40 mix: Option A -> $800 / 1M; Option B -> $680 / 1M; Option C -> $590 / 1M

Notes and asks for procurement:
- If GreenByte can commit to an annual minimum (e.g., 120M tokens) we can move the Option B pricing floor down by ~$20/1M in the blended bands; Karthik, please confirm if an annual floor has the same margin effect as pure committed tokens.
- We should include a standard SLA credit and a one-time migration support credit in the term sheet.

Alex — happy to set a 30-minute call next week with Karthik if procurement wants to talk details. Otherwise Ben, feel free to push the term sheet and we’ll prepare a final pricing appendix once Saeed flags the preferred option.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
